candidates.title: Hyderabad: Rowdy sheeter hacked to death in permit room at Bandlaguda
candidates.excerpt: A rowdy sheeter identified as Nayeem from Yellandu was hacked to death by unidentified assailants at a wine shop permit room in Bandlaguda under Nagole Police Station limits. Police suspect old enmity and gang rivalry behind the murder.

candidates.title: Well done Congress: KTR warns Telangana is on brink of chaos
candidates.excerpt: BRS working president KT Rama Rao accused the Congress government of pushing Telangana towards chaos following the alleged attack on his PRO and PA inside Saifabad police station. He warned that such incidents could escalate into lynching and street violence.

candidates.title: Four members of family die in fire at home in Belagavi
candidates.excerpt: Two members of the family are undergoing treatment for injuries

candidates.title: Jharkhand CID arrests two more in recruitment exam irregularities cases
candidates.excerpt: Dilip Kumar Paswan (41) of Bihar's Jamui district was arrested in connection with alleged irregularities in the JSSC Combined Graduate Level (CGL) examination-2023, he said.

candidates.title: In loss for Trump, U.S. Supreme Court won't let Postal Service restrict mail ballots
candidates.excerpt: Justice Samuel Alito, joined by fellow conservative Justice Clarence Thomas, dissented from the decision, comparing some ‌of the challengers’ claims to a “Hail Mary pass” that is “unlikely to be successfully completed,” using a football analogy

candidates.title: Digital libraries established in 57,600 gram panchayats: UP CM Yogi
candidates.excerpt: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath inaugurated the 5th Gomti Book Festival-2026, tells youth to build their own book bank

candidates.title: Iran’s IRGC says oil tanker explodes after hitting naval mines in Hormuz Strait
candidates.excerpt: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said an oil tanker identified as EL GAIA exploded and caught fire after hitting naval mines while attempting to cross the Strait of Hormuz through a forbidden route, as Tehran maintained that the waterway remains closed.

candidates.title: Former DUTA chief Aditya Narayan Mishra joins Congress, flags ‘crisis’ in education
candidates.excerpt: Mr. Mishra joined the party in the presence of Delhi Congress in-charge Qazi Nizamuddin, Delhi Pradesh Congress Committee president Devender Yadav, AICC Uttar Pradesh in-charge Rajendra Pal Gautam and other party leaders

candidates.title: Look at results and understand what India achieved at BRICS, says Uruguay FM
candidates.excerpt: Uruguay's Foreign Minister Mario Lubetkin praised India's leadership of BRICS and PM Narendra Modi's role in achieving consensus on the New Delhi Declaration. He also outlined plans to deepen India-Uruguay ties and advance cooperation through Mercosur and CELAC.

candidates.title: Zelensky says Ukraine ready to halt strikes if Russia does the same
candidates.excerpt: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said Kyiv is ready to halt certain strikes if Russia does the same, particularly against energy facilities and critical infrastructure. His remarks came after Donald Trump said both sides had agreed to stop energy-related attacks.

candidates.title: Saudi pipeline hit by drones to be out of service for weeks
candidates.excerpt: Cairo: A crucial Saudi oil pipeline that was struck in an attack will be mostly out of service for weeks as the damage is repaired, two regional officials said Monday, September 13, as Yemen’s Houthi rebels seized more islands along Red Sea shipping routes in a new blow to Saudi Arabia’s oil exports. candidates.title: Trump’s Bombardier jet ban threat sparks alarm among US workers
candidates.excerpt: US workers at Bombardier fear job losses after President Donald Trump threatened restrictions on the Canadian aircraft maker’s jets. The company employs thousands across the US, while aviation supply chains between the two countries remain closely connected.
